items.title: Get on line because Disney parks drove Q3 growth, earnings lift stock
items.summary: Disney (DIS) shares are getting some gains Wednesday morning after the House of Mouse reported streaming and its theme parks to be the main growth drivers in its fiscal third quarter, Morning Brief Host Julie Hyman is joined by Yahoo Finance Senior Reporter Pras Subramanian and Breaking News Reporter Jake Conley to examine the experiences demand at Disney parks and the companies performance under its latest CEO Josh D'Amaro.

items.title: Disney profits top estimates on strength in theme park business
items.summary: Disney reported better-than-expected profits Wednesday, citing a strong performance in its theme park business amid lingering worries about macroeconomic weakness.However Disney cited upside in theme park attendance and retail products built around the franchises.

items.title: Disney's Streaming and Parks Drive Third-Quarter Profits
items.summary: Walt Disney's profit beat Wall Street estimates in the company's fiscal third quarter, driven by soaring income from its entertainment division and the resilience of its theme parks in California and Florida. Bloomberg's Geetha Ranganathan joins Bloomberg Intelligence to discuss Disney as well as Paramount Skydance's earnings.

items.title: Disney Climbs on Profit Beat; AMD Falls on Underwhelming Forecast | Stock Movers
items.summary: On this episode of Stock Movers: - Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) shares are lower after the semiconductor firm's second-quarter revenue and third-quarter sales forecast underwhelmed investors expecting a stronger performance given rising demand. - Disney (DIS) shares are climbing as profit beat Wall Street estimates in the company's fiscal third quarter, driven by soaring income from its entertainment division and the resilience of its theme parks in California and Florida. - Shopify (SHOP) shares are soaring after it reported revenue for the second quarter that beat the average analyst estimate. President Harley Finkelstein said it was a "monster quarter" for the company.
